hero_eyebrow: Experienced Plasterers & Decorators — Quality Finishes Guaranteed
hero_subhead: Transform your home with expert plastering and decoration. Fast, clean work from a team you can trust.
services_subhead: From interior feature walls and exterior cladding to specialist finishes, we handle residential and commercial projects of all sizes.

services.title: Interior Plastering
services.desc: Smooth wall finishes, coving installation, and damage repair. We create perfectly flat surfaces ready for paint or wallpaper, restoring tired rooms to like-new condition.

services.title: Exterior Rendering
services.desc: Weather-resistant rendered finishes that protect and beautify. Ideal for modernising older properties or adding durability to exposed walls.

services.title: Decorating & Painting
services.desc: Interior and exterior painting using quality finishes. We prepare surfaces thoroughly, offer colour consultation, and apply professional-grade paint for long-lasting results.

services.title: Textured Finishes
services.desc: Specialist textured coatings, artexing, and polished plaster effects. Add character and disguise imperfections with these popular contemporary and traditional finishes.

services.title: Wallpapering
services.desc: Expert hanging of standard and feature wallpapers, including textured and vinyl options. We match patterns precisely and leave your walls looking sharp and professional.

services.title: Commercial Decoration
services.desc: Office, retail, and hospitality decoration on time and within budget. We work flexibly around business hours to minimise disruption.

about_pullquote: We turn up on time, do the job right, and tidy up after ourselves.
about_para_1: M & S Plastering & Decorating Services has been serving Southampton and surrounding areas for over 15 years. We started because we wanted to prove that skilled tradespeople don't have to be hard to reach or inflexible. Today, we're known for reliable, high-quality work on everything from small decorating projects to full property refurbishments.
about_para_2: Our customers come back because we listen, we prepare surfaces properly (not cut corners), and we respect your home. We're fully insured, tidy, and we quote fairly — no hidden costs or upsell tactics. Whether you need a single bedroom redecorated or a whole-house renovation, we bring the same professionalism and attention to detail.

reviews.text: Had the kitchen and hallway redecorated. They arrived on time, worked efficiently, and the finish is brilliant. No mess left behind, which was a huge relief. Would definitely recommend.
reviews.author: David T.

reviews.text: Plastered our lounge ceiling after a leak. The surface is absolutely smooth now. Professional job, fair price, and they explained everything as they went. Really pleased.
reviews.author: Claire M.

reviews.text: Been using M & S for 3 jobs now. They always turn up when they say they will, take pride in their work, and treat your home with respect. That's rare these days. Highly recommend.
reviews.author: Michael P.
